what: Below the swatch button row an indicator bar slides to the next swatch every two beats over .75 beat, and the matching panel changes in an overlapping way (runs on its own). Clicking a swatch stops the cycle and stays on that panel. Stops when off screen

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
options.every: Advance every how many beats, default 2

from.where: index.js DEMOS.themes (cycles through four theme swatches)
